components[].checks.*.exemptions:positiv.reason: Frozen read exemptions under a component's own check table but never consulted them (only root exemptions relax a requirement), so the declaration was silently inert. Native refuses it as an unknown key so authors move the reasoned exemption to the root.

components[].id:slash.reason: Intended contract change: native component ids name monorepo packages (automatic discovery uses the package directory, e.g. rust/one), so the frozen lowercase [a-z0-9._-] identifier rule is not applied blindly. Native still requires a non-empty, at most 128-character, control-free id, unique within the workspace.

components[].id:uppercase.reason: Intended contract change (same as components[].id:slash): native component ids are bounded printable package names and keep the author's case; the frozen lowercase-only domain rule is not applied.

components[].languages:unknown_value.reason: Frozen accepted an unsupported language name and then selected no files for it. Native refuses unsupported language names so a typo cannot become an empty PASS scope.

components[].python.test_tools:unknown_v.reason: Frozen stored any test_tools text without meaning. Native refuses values other than project/bundle instead of silently treating a typo as the default.

local.builds.*.directory:undeclared.reason: Frozen silently ignored a local overlay for a build no root declares, so the author believed it took effect. Native refuses it by name, consistent with the overlay's refuse-rather-than-ignore contract.

local.components.*.python.executable:und.reason: Frozen silently ignored a local interpreter for an undeclared component. Native refuses the overlay key by name instead of ignoring it.

publish.branch:blank.reason: Frozen silently replaced a whitespace-only branch with gh-pages. Native refuses the blank value; omitting branch still selects gh-pages.

tools.*.config:escape.reason: Frozen next-v1 read [tools] but never composed it, so an escaping tool config path was silently ignored. Native resolves tool paths for providers and refuses a config path outside the workspace.

workspace.profile:unknown_value.reason: Frozen next-v1 stored any profile text and ignored unknown values when selecting checks. Native refuses anything but fast/standard/deep, because the profile selects which checks run.
